var LendingErrorCodes
type Lend struct
  ID string
  Engine string
  Store string
  Object string
  Name string
  Link string
  Kind Link
  Size int64
  Created string
type LendResult struct
  Outcome LendOutcome
  Lend *Lend
  Detail string
type UnlendResult struct
  Outcome UnlendOutcome
  Detail string
type LendPage struct
  Outcome LendsOutcome
  Lends []Lend
  Continuation string
  Complete bool
func Encode(v *LendResult) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*LendResult, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type Lending interface
  Lend(store, object, engine string, copy_ bool) (LendResult, error)
  Unlend(entry string) (UnlendResult, error)
  Lends(continuation string, limit int64) (LendPage, error)
type LendingTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type LendingClient struct
func NewLendingClient(t LendingTransport) *LendingClient
type LendingDispatcher struct
  Handler Lending
func (LendingClient) Lend(store, object, engine string, copy_ bool) (result LendResult, err error)
func (LendingClient) Unlend(entry string) (result UnlendResult, err error)
func (LendingClient) Lends(continuation string, limit int64) (result LendPage, err error)
func (LendingDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (LendingDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (LendingDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (LendingDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (LendingDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
